description: Voies navigables relevant du domaine public fluvial en Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Tracé des voies navigables gérées par le Département de Loire-Atlantique Canal de Nantes à Brest Rivière de la Sèvre navigable (sèvre nantaise jusqu'à Monnières) Rigole d'alimentation Rivière de l'Erdre Voir aussi: Horaires de l'écluse Saint-Félix en Loire-Atlantique. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transport fluvial, canal, domaine public. The portal shows 135 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
